title: San Gennaro Catacombs Tickets: How to Book and What to Expect
metaTitle: San Gennaro Catacombs Tickets: How to Book (Guide)
metaDescription: How to buy San Gennaro Catacombs tickets in Naples: ticket types, guided visits, time slots and tips for booking ahead.
excerpt: Which ticket to choose, why time slots matter, and how to book your visit to the Catacombs of San Gennaro.
quickAnswer: Compare the tickets on our homepage, pick a date and time slot, and book online with instant mobile confirmation. Guided visits are the best way to understand the site.

content.text: The Catacombs of San Gennaro in Naples are visited in scheduled time slots, so the simplest way to secure your place is to book a ticket in advance. This guide explains how the ticket options differ and what to check before you book.
Ticket types

Options generally fall into two groups: entry tickets and guided visits. Guided visits explain the frescoes, basilicas and burial areas, and are the most popular choice. Each ticket on this site lists its guide, language and duration.
Why book ahead
Visits run at set times and groups are limited in size, so popular slots at weekends and in holiday periods can fill up. Booking ahead lets you choose the time that fits your day.
Before you confirm
Check the language of the visit, the meeting point and arrival time, the cancellation terms and any accessibility information on the booking page.

title: How to Get to the San Gennaro Catacombs in Naples
metaTitle: How to Get to the San Gennaro Catacombs, Naples
metaDescription: Directions to the San Gennaro Catacombs at Via Capodimonte 13, Naples — by bus, taxi or on foot through Rione Sanità.
excerpt: Directions to the catacombs in Rione Sanità by bus, taxi or on foot.
quickAnswer: The entrance is at Via Capodimonte 13, beside the Basilica Madre del Buon Consiglio. Take a taxi or bus toward Capodimonte, or walk up through Rione Sanità.

content.text: The San Gennaro Catacombs sit on the slope of Capodimonte hill in Naples' Rione Sanità neighbourhood. The entrance is at Via Capodimonte 13, next to the Basilica Madre del Buon Consiglio.
By taxi
A taxi from central Naples is the quickest option and avoids the climb. Ask for the Catacombe di San Gennaro on Via Capodimonte.
By bus
City buses serve the Capodimonte area. Check the current routes and stops with the local transport operator before you travel, as services change.
On foot
Walking through Rione Sanità is rewarding but hilly, with narrow streets. Allow extra time and wear comfortable shoes.
Arriving
Your voucher confirms the meeting point and arrival time. Arrive a little early so you can check in calmly.

title: Guided Visit or Entry Ticket? Choosing for the San Gennaro Catacombs
metaTitle: San Gennaro Catacombs: Guided Visit vs Entry Ticket
metaDescription: Should you book a guided visit or an entry ticket for the San Gennaro Catacombs? What each option includes and who it suits.
excerpt: What a guided visit adds, and when a simple entry ticket is enough.
quickAnswer: Choose a guided visit if you want the history, frescoes and story of San Gennaro explained. An entry ticket suits visitors who prefer to see the site on their own terms where that is offered.

content.text: Choosing between a guided visit and an entry ticket comes down to how much context you want underground.
What a guided visit adds
A guide explains the two levels of galleries, the Basilica of St Agrippinus, the frescoes and the story of St Januarius, and keeps the visit moving at a comfortable pace.
When an entry ticket is enough
If you already know the history or prefer to explore independently, an entry ticket may suit you — check whether the option you are looking at includes a guide or information materials.
How to decide
Read the language, duration and inclusions on each ticket, then pick the visit that matches your time and interest.

title: Things to Do Near the San Gennaro Catacombs
metaTitle: Things to Do Near the San Gennaro Catacombs, Naples
metaDescription: Nearby attractions around the San Gennaro Catacombs: Rione Sanità, San Gaudioso Catacombs, Capodimonte Museum and more.
excerpt: Make a half-day of it with Rione Sanità, San Gaudioso and the Capodimonte area.
quickAnswer: Pair your visit with Rione Sanità, the Catacombs of San Gaudioso and the Capodimonte area, all close by.

content.text: The catacombs are in one of Naples' most characterful neighbourhoods, so it is easy to build a half-day around your visit.
Rione Sanità
A historic quarter of lively streets, churches and local life, reached on foot from the catacombs.
Catacombs of San Gaudioso
Nearby catacombs beneath the Basilica of Santa Maria della Sanità, known for their distinctive painted burials.
Capodimonte
The Capodimonte area above the catacombs is home to a major museum and a large park.
Plan your day
Book your catacombs time slot first, then fit nearby sights around it.
